claude_proposed_widenings.name: armed_on_hit_rider
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The poison coating is armed via a Bonus Action activation (use_count 1, resets at dawn) and then fires a save gate on the *next* weapon hit. No current family expresses this pattern: on_hit_trigger has no arming/activation step; activation family has no on-hit phase kind. A new 'arm then fire on hit' subgraph is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take a Bonus Action to magically coat the blade with poison. The poison remains for 1 minute or until an attack using this weapon hits a creature. That creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: SaveGateRiderResult.damage_and_condition
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The on-hit save gate's fail branch requires both 2d10 Poison damage AND the Poisoned condition. SaveGateRiderResult is limited to apply_condition | none and cannot express a damage instance. A damage variant (or composite) is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: That creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 2d10 Poison damage and have the Poisoned condition for 1 minute.
